added.title: Safety & Environmental Compliance Lead
added.description:
Monde Nissin Corporation in Laguna, Philippines seeks an OSH professional to develop, implement, and monitor safety, health, and environmental programs ensuring regulatory compliance and company standards. The role focuses on promoting a safe workplace while minimizing environmental impact.

The candidate should hold a BOSH Certification and preferably a DOLE Accredited OSH Practitioner, with 3–5 years in manufacturing and strong collaboration skills.
